newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms as forex demand drops off.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms as forex demand drops off.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer at 471.00/472.00 per dollar Tuesday, compared to 472.00/473.00 per dollar Monday as demand for foreign currency dried up, traders said.
"There was absolutely no demand for dollars," one trader said.
Traders added that some banks and investors had sold foreign currency ahead of Wednesday's Central Bank Monetray Stabilization, or TEM, bill auction.
The currency was likely to lose some ground Wednesday after the auction, the added.
